text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:

2. **#4419**, gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. Source: `teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md` (Moss, undated cheat sheet). The note says it was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.

It isn't one of Moss's notes, so I left it out of the list above. The two descriptions don't match, so confirm which is right.
- Moss's 2025-09-14 pipeline digest and 2026-03-23 renewal check-in mention Quarrendon but give no ticket number.

I can't write to your weekly notes folder with the tools I have, so this list is here for you to paste in.
